snippet.title: Map Map - A Game About Maps release trailer | Thinky Direct 2026
snippet.description:
In this game YOU make the maps! Become the cartographer of a small adventure crew and use proper navigation tools like a real explorer. Map the environment to turn unknown islands into a hand-drawn journey toward a legendary treasure.

Map Map - A Game About Maps by @pipapogames  is out today as part of the Thinky Direct 2026!

Map Map - A Game About Maps in the Thinky Games DB:
https://thinkygames.com/games/map-map/
Map Map - A Game About Maps on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2702260/Map_Map__A_Game_About_Maps/

More info about the Thinky Direct:
https://thinkygames.com/events/direct/2026/
